Every lagoon has a toy shop behind it, every marble a ledger, every sable a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. 9 days of clean conduct buys the stake back; until then the farm's 43870 POA answers to the panel, not the farm.
